name: Does AKN Design Group handle construction for rental properties or investment units?

mainEntity.name: Does AKN Design Group handle construction for rental properties or investment units?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group specializes in comprehensive residential renovations, and our expertise extends to significant transformations that can enhance the value and functionality of residential rental or investment properties. We focus on projects like whole-home remodels, kitchen renovations, or bathroom upgrades that require a managed design-build process, ensuring high-quality results for your investment. We are best suited for substantial improvements rather than minor repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, AKN Design Group undertakes significant residential renovations for rental or investment properties that benefit from our managed design-build process and focus on quality.
